title: Physical-recovery specification carrier readiness

authorizationContext.interpretation: one local offline governed-discovery pre-review cycle only

discoveryFrame.before: draft the successor product specification from the accepted H-050 intent
discoveryFrame.architecturalQuestion: Can the exact accepted H-050 intent be projected losslessly into the current product-specification carrier without silently turning extends and references into supersedes or inventing policy?
discoveryFrame.overclaimToAvoid: that a source-cited abstract map is a specification, proves arbitrary prose representability, authorizes drafting, or establishes a safe recovery mechanism
discoveryFrame.minimalRefutingSlice: close the exact law, representation, and H-050 sources; map each accepted decision only to a finite abstract-slot universe; and expose every unresolved carrier predicate
discoveryFrame.observableEvidence: exact source hashes and JSON pointers, eleven structurally reconstructed predicate receipts whose semantic classifications remain pending human acceptance, zero omitted mappings, one ambiguous relationship predicate, and one unresolved schema-compiler predicate
discoveryFrame.outOfScopeAndDeferred: SPEC-shaped fixtures, field prose, identifiers, actors, terms, requirements, stories, workflows, profile or schema mutation, mechanism selection, live evidence, and every operational transition
discoveryFrame.reorderResult: the first move changes from specification drafting to carrier-readiness refutation

question: Does the closed H-050 intent admit a non-inventive, conflict-free, additive product-specification projection under the current carrier?

epistemicClaims.statement: The exact H-050 accepted intent contains nine explicit decisions, selects no mechanism, and grants no specification, ADR, implementation, or action authority.
epistemicClaims.evidence: Candidate motion SHA-256 20aa95c65dd0fb05bc21d7d98e7ba839895de5ded959b781db9d32893e1e1e28 and human acceptance SHA-256 d392ec651f80cdd715ef7482a829b823631fc94ceb8abf926e957c7f7f690602.

epistemicClaims.statement: The current product-specification JSON schema exposes supersedes but no typed extends or references property, while the profile carrier exposes a set of active specification identifiers.
epistemicClaims.evidence: Exact main@2810e63 specification schema, profile schema, and profile blobs admitted by the H-051 source lock.

epistemicClaims.statement: Eight H-050 decisions map to the finite abstract-slot universe without an observed source conflict; the relationship decision remains ambiguous between prose and a machine-readable carrier.
The contextual reply authorizes only this local evidence-writing governed-discovery cycle because its text digest recurs and must be interpreted together with the exact H-050 predecessor closure.
epistemicClaims.evidence: Model-visible reply digest, CHG-0030 digest, H-050 closure digest, and the immediately preceding handoff.

epistemicClaims.statement: Whether prose is an adequate carrier for extends and references, whether a machine-readable relation is required, and whether the schema/compiler admits the desired additive lifecycle remain unresolved.
epistemicClaims.evidence: mapsSpecificationRelationship is ambiguous; schemaCompilerAdmitsAdditiveLifecycle is unresolved; no SPEC-shaped fixture or human adjudication is authorized.

claimBoundary.conclusion: H-051 can report only source-closed abstract projection readiness and the exact unresolved carrier predicates
claimBoundary.nonAuthority: neither the docket nor map is a specification, product law, an ADR candidate, implementation authority, or approval of its own classifications
claimBoundary.exhaustiveness: the finite abstract-slot universe is closed, but arbitrary prose semantics cannot be exhaustively refuted without human judgment
claimBoundary.excluded: SPEC or ADR creation, accepted-record mutation, profile or compiler change, product or mechanism behavior, live state, host mutation, Git history, and publication

adrAssessment.reason: The Slice exposes an unresolved representation choice and selects no durable architecture or mechanism.
